title: Global MMLU: Understanding and Addressing Cultural and Linguistic Biases in Multilingual Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured knowledge of world religions as a subject category ('World Religions') within a broader assessment of cultural, geographical, and dialect-specific knowledge.
findings: The 'World Religions' subject within the MMLU dataset was found to have 100% of its questions requiring culturally-sensitive knowledge (i.e., cultural, regional, or dialect-specific references).
references: Aakanksha, Arash Ahmadian, Beyza Ermis, Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant, Julia Kreutzer, Marzieh Fadaee, and Sara Hooker.
